source.revision_note: Revision 2 changes only the native layout/presentation code (MicroSIP-like tab strip, keypad, edit row, disabled Call/End, disabled volume rows, compact DND/MUTE/HOLD/XFER, bottom status bar; 300x460 window). Same manifest, same isolated lockfile, no new crate or version.

capture.dpi: 96 DPI explicitly configured on Xvfb; client viewport captured at one pixel per logical point

capture.tooling: xwd native window pixels, ImageMagick lossless PNG encoding; no resizing/crop/compositing/retouching
capture.readiness: private X display/window detection plus two-second first-frame settling period; all final images visually inspected
